name: High Protein Oats
ingredients_raw: Instant Oats (46%), Protein Blend (26.6%) (Texturised Soy Protein Flakes, Whey Powder), Dehydrated Fruits, Nuts & Seeds (12%) (Raisins, Chia Seeds, Sunflower Seeds, Almonds 0.5%, Pumpkin Seeds), Cocoa Powder (7%), Fructo-Oligosaccharides, Natural Flavours, Rice Bran Oil, Himalayan Pink Salt, Sweetener (Steviol Glycosides), Probiotics (Bacillus Coagulans SNZ 1969, 15 Billion CFU/g).
